defect_line: POST /v2/refunds is always idempotent, so retries are safe in every case.
reply:
POST /v2/refunds is always idempotent, so retries are safe in every case.
Without the header a retry can create a duplicate refund.

excerpts.text: POST /v2/refunds: idempotent when the Idempotency-Key header is sent. Without it, a retry may create a duplicate refund.
